answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the reef of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The orchard holds work receipts rather than names, so the violet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on time-locked work history, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
